biography:
Strategic Leadership | Global Utilities | Power Infrastructure | Power Solutions | Data Center Development | Sustainability | Portfolio Management 

As Vice President of Global Utilities, at Yondr, Osama leads the development and execution of large-scale energy strategies that enable sustainable hyperscale data center growth globally. With 15+ years of experience—including leadership roles at Amazon Web Services and within engineering consultancies serving the utilities sector—He brings a strategic, data-driven approach to solving complex infrastructure challenges.

He has successfully secured multi-GW of power, negotiated $1 billion+ power contracts, and played a key role in securing 300MW IT of leases for Yondr. He oversees a global portfolio of utility assets to optimise investments, mitigate risk, and drive long-term resilience. He specialises in strategic planning, stakeholder alignment, and execution at scale, ensuring that power infrastructure meets the evolving demands of the international digital economy.

He leads and drives operational excellence for the Utilities department, fostering foresight, adaptability, and innovation—empowering the anticipation of market shifts, acceleration of site readiness, and secure investor and client confidence in Yondr sites worldwide.

He is a Chartered Engineer who hold an MBA, a Master’s in Sustainability, and a Bachelor’s degree in Power Engineering,, equipping him with a unique blend of technical expertise, environmental strategy, and business leadership to drive innovative and scalable energy solutions.

In 2023, Infrastructure Masons recognized his contributions to the digital infrastructure industry with the prestigious IM100 award, acknowledging his commitment to advancing sustainable, scalable energy solutions in the global digital infrastructure.
